name: glm
description: GLM Coding Plan toolkit for Claude Code. /glm:usage queries your Zhipu/Z.ai usage limits (5-hour & 7-day windows) from the official monitor API and renders an official-/usage-style panel. glm-statusline-on/off wraps the Claude Code statusline: shows GLM usage in the StatusBar on a Zhipu backend, passes through your original statusline otherwise. Reads ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from the environment only — never in plaintext.
